entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That reminds me... you're leaving for[n]Hawaii tomorrow, right?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That's enough help for today. Go on and[n]head up to bed.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Have fun. I'll make sure I keep working[n]on you-know-what after I'm done taking[n]a breather.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: By the way, Sojiro... are people on[n]probation even allowed out of the[n]country?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: As his guardian, if I approve, it's all good.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I mean, not letting a kid take part in[n]school events probably wouldn't be[n]good for his rehab.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Huh... But if anything bad happens on the[n]trip, it'll be the school's responsibility.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Monaaa, I'm gonna be your master[n]from tomorrow on!

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.en: Aren't you gonna ask for any souvenirs[n]from Hawaii? No hula doll or anything?

entries.speaker: Morgana

Is something wrong, Morgana?
Seems normal to me.
Do you wish you could come?

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Hmph.

entries.speaker: Morgana
